analysis.decision_reason: Program 19.0 Phase 4 explicitly forbids: router restructuring, URL changes, request/response changes. Consolidating workspace routers into main routers would require either URL changes or router restructuring, both forbidden. Additionally, the workspace routers serve distinct /api/v1/<entity> paths consumed by frontend workspace pages (e.g., frontend/app/behaviour/workspace-page.tsx calls /api/v1/behaviour). No duplicate registrations exist - each workspace router has a unique path. No obsolete registrations found.

Runtime reachability analysis marks these as 'never_reachable' in the capability execution graph. However, these routers are consumed by frontend workspace pages via HTTP API calls (e.g., frontend/app/cashflow/ calls /api/cashflow). Removing them would break frontend functionality. Program 19.0 Phase 4 forbids URL changes and request/response changes. The unreachable classification is about backend capability chain traversal, not actual frontend API usage. No action taken.

additional_notes: No duplicate registrations found - all 28 routers have unique paths.
No obsolete registrations found - all routers are registered in api.py and consumed by frontend.
